Reveal full title
Establish: The Garden Gate
Hello, hello, HELLO, my friends! It's me — Buzzy!
Audience beat: Can you wave hello to Buzzy?
Here's a big question. How do you know what's happening around you?
Audience beat: How do you find things out? Have a think!
Ooh. With my eyes? I look at things.
Yes! And that's called a sense. Your sense of sight.
A sense? Is there more than one?
There are five! Five senses, Lily. And today, we're going to find ever
Five! Let's go and find them!
Audience beat: Count with me — how many senses are we looking for?
Five it is. Come on, everybody. Let's have a sense-ational adventure!
Establish: Sense One — Seeing
Here we are! Sense number one.
Everybody, put your hands over your eyes. Go on!
Audience beat: Cover your eyes with your hands!
Not a thing! It's all dark.
Now — open them up!
Wow. The colours!
That's your sense of SIGHT. Your eyes let you see colours, and shapes,
Let's practise. I'll say a colour, and you find it.
Audience beat: Point at something red!
I found a red tulip!
Beautiful. Now something YELLOW.
Audience beat: Point at something yellow!
The middle of the daisy is yellow!
Now here's the tricky one. Something GREEN.
Audience beat: Where is something green?
That's easy. The grass, the leaves, the stems — green, green, green!
Brilliant looking, everybody. That's sense number one: seeing.
Audience beat: Hold up one finger. One sense found!
Establish: Sense Two — Hearing
Tweet! Tweet-tweet!
Oh! Did you hear that?
I did! Who was that?
It was me! Hello, I'm Pip.
Everybody, this is sense number two.
Close your eyes for me. Now — what can you hear?
Audience beat: Close your eyes and listen!
I can hear Pip singing!
And the water going splish, splash.
And the wind in the leaves. Shhhhhh.
Open your eyes! That was your sense of HEARING. Your ears did all of t
My ears were working the whole time and I didn't even know!
Buzzy reaches out and rings a little bell
Now, listen very carefully. Is this sound LOUD, or is it QUIET?
Audience beat: Loud or quiet?
Audience beat: Loud or quiet?
That one made me jump!
Let's make a sound together! Can you clap your hands?
Audience beat: Clap along with us!
What a wonderful noise. That's sense number two: hearing.
Audience beat: Hold up two fingers. Two senses!
Establish: Sense Three — Smelling
Mmmmm. Oh, my goodness. Come and smell this.
What is it?
It's the flower. Take a big breath in through your nose.
Audience beat: Take a deep breath in through your nose!
Ohhh! It's sweet! Like honey!
That's sense number three. SMELLING. Your nose is doing that.
Dotty the ladybird arrives, holding her nose
Ugh! Has anybody been near the compost heap?
Oh dear. Dotty found a not-so-lovely one.
Audience beat: What's your favourite smell? Tell me!
Mine is bread. Warm bread from the oven.
And mine is flowers, of course. I'm a bee!
Audience beat: Hold up three fingers!
Establish: Sense Four — Tasting
Now this one — this one is my favourite.
What's in the basket, Buzzy?
Take a little taste. Just a little one.
Mmmm! It's SWEET!
Sense number four. TASTING. Your tongue knows sweet, and salty, and so
Sour? What's sour?
Oh, Dotty. You're going to find out.
It's yellow. It looks lovely.
Audience beat: Do you think a lemon is sweet or sour?
And remember — we only taste things we know are safe.
Always ask a grown-up first!
Exactly right. That's four!
Audience beat: Hold up four fingers!
Establish: Sense Five — Touching
One more to find. Just one!
The last sense! What is it?
Feel this moss. Go on, reach out with me.
Audience beat: Reach out your hand and touch something soft!
It's soft! Like a little cushion.
That's sense number five. TOUCHING. And your skin does it.
Dotty picks up a pinecone
Ooh! This one isn't soft at all!
What does it feel like, Dotty?
Bumpy. And a bit prickly.
Bumpy and prickly. Lovely describing.
And this rock is smooth. And cold!
Smooth. Cold. Rough. Warm. Soft. Your skin knows them all.
Audience beat: Can you feel your own cheek? Is it soft?
And that's five! We found all five!
Establish: The Five Senses Song
We did it! Let's count them all together.
Number one — my eyes can SEE.
Audience beat: Point to your eyes!
Audience beat: Point to your ears!
Audience beat: Point to your nose, then your tongue!
Audience beat: Wiggle your fingers!
Five senses! Let's sing it!
Sing along with me, everybody!
Audience beat: Sing along! Eyes to see and ears to hear!
A nose to smell the flowers near,
A tongue to taste our lunch today,
And skin to feel along the way!
Five senses, five senses, one two three four five!
Five senses, five senses, they help us feel alive!
Everybody cheers and jumps
So next time you're outside, have a go.
Thank you for coming on our sense-ational adventure!
Audience beat: Wave goodbye to Buzzy!
Goodbye wave
End card with call to action
